name: Tsubasa no Oka no Hime: A Red and Blue Moon -Finite Loop-
original_name: つばさの丘の姫王 A red and blue moon -finite loop-
source:
The story is set at the 19th century at the United Kingdom, in a rural town called Wingfield.

An apprentice butler, Christopher Luckenbooth, had been sent from London by the Principle of the School of Butlers here. His duty, is to serve the local feudal lord, Lady Vivian N.M.N Wingfield.
As he steps forth into the world where spirits and fairies reside, many others who served the lady of the mansion awaits.
A stern looking butler to act as his guide.
A wolf who could speak the language of a human.
A maid chief whose appearance was of a child's.
An overbearing old butler who never does his job.
And a cook who looked like he was from the East.

As the Lady's 19th birthday approaches, so is the festival that the town prepared specially for her, and so is the day that all the mystery that is surrounding her comes to light..
translation:
故事设定在19世纪英国一座名为温菲尔德的乡间小镇。

见习管家克里斯托弗·拉肯布思受伦敦管家学校校长派遣来到这里，他的职责是侍奉当地领主薇薇安·N.M.N·温菲尔德小姐。
当他踏入精灵与妖精栖息的世界，许多同样侍奉宅邸女主人的人正等待着他：
一位神情严厉、负责指导他的管家；
一匹会说人类语言的狼；
一位外表如同孩童的女仆长；
一位盛气凌人、从不干活的老管家；
还有一位看上去来自东方的厨师。

薇薇安小姐的19岁生日逐渐临近，小镇为她特别筹备的庆典也即将到来；与此同时，萦绕在她身边的一切谜团也将迎来揭晓之日。
